findings.summary: Direct CLI caller authentication was missing before the bounded credential binding correction.
Backup and restore now retain durable maintenance jobs and exact replay readback; crash and native evidence remain open.
Status projections now expose canonical action facts, while incomplete proof remains fail-closed and full descriptors are not yet wired.
The production oracle now uses an external source manifest rather than a self-referential tracked commit hash.
PF-S02 leaf handoffs, independent review, real-service acceptance and release evidence are not certified at this tree.
